authorization: User asked to execute the preceding proposal, create a complete video and a new branch; no intermediate approval is needed.
audience: Game pitch jury / mentors; no formal scoring rubric supplied.
hook: Hair-powered physical cooperation: carry, sling through gel, relay an enemy scissor into a bell.
primary_ask: Play the prototype; recruit the next cohort of 20 pairs and seek mentoring.
truth_rules: No invented player results, traction, awards, member responsibilities or funding commitments.
12 weeks and USD 17,200 are a proposed production plan, not a launch promise or funding already secured.
Capture uses the real Godot renderer, physics, inputs and game audio. Any staged boss setup is documented as a mechanic demonstration.
Hair swap changes the existing two friends' abilities, not the playable roster.
Use an isolated capture save, never the user's normal progress.
direction: Hand-drawn salon comedy; clean full-frame gameplay; pink and blue role markers; restrained ink titles and elastic punctuation. A continuous action takes priority over decorative motion.

requirement_decisions.decision: 14 sections; gameplay hook, cooperation proof, audience, current build, team, proposed plan/budget, playable CTA

requirement_decisions.requirement: Show why two people are needed
requirement_decisions.decision: Show carry alone failing, then the complete sling; show horizontal parry contrasted with an upward relay
Keep full voice and music/effects stems, clean picture, per-line audio and editable SRT
Use feat/pitch-v3 and a separate v3 Remotion entry without changing the v2 composition

gallery_adaptation.preserved: seeded dry-brush geometry; stroke f32-42; resting hold
gallery_adaptation.adapted: game palette, width and caption-safe placement
gallery_adaptation.other_shots: custom editorial gameplay, not claimed as Gallery copies

shotcraft_adaptations: Use the product-derived palette, preproduction specification, feature-to-shot mapping, hold/rest time, frame-pinned SFX, deterministic motion, two audio versions and independent final review.
Game-specific exceptions to product-advert rules S1/Q8: retain actual game audio and characterful game music; no tech-house requirement, metallic UI orbit or launch-event particle finale.
Gameplay camera treatments are custom editorial shots: source-frame spatial continuity and readable targets take priority over a template's camera movement.
reference_video_method: Video identity and chapters checked; author's official companion article supplies the verified recommendations: snappy gameplay walkthrough, clear audience path, concise budget. No claim to have transcribed the full talk.
